summary: Specifies a packetization scheme for carrying uncompressed video in RTP. It supports a range of standard- and high-definition formats, including television formats such as ITU BT.601 and SMPTE standards. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Video is a stack of pictures. This memo cuts raw, uncompressed pictures into chunks small enough to mail over the internet and shows how to put them back together.

questions: how to send raw video over rtp
